title: Unique.domains for Node: the SDK and the command line of the Unique.domains API
description:
The Node packages of the Unique.domains API. One call tells whether a domain name is taken, what its registry record says, what nine registrars charge for its ending and what similar names sold for, from a record of 34 million one-word names read every day. You can read the same record yourself: a name at https://unique.domains/whois, the nine price lists at https://unique.domains/registrars.

@uniquedomains/sdk is a typed client for every endpoint, with methods grouped by what they read. @uniquedomains/cli runs every endpoint as a command, with nothing to install: npx @uniquedomains/cli get-name get.plumbing. Four smaller packages each answer one question, from code or as a command: WHOIS lookup, availability, registrar price comparison and appraisal.

Without a key, the API answers 62 of its 87 operations, 20 rows a page, within 60 calls an hour and 100 a day from one address. The other 25 operations need a key. Documentation: https://unique.domains/api.
